brief:
Syrian analyst Hisham Darwish told Shehab Wire that recent Israeli airstrikes on Abu al-Dhuhur airport represent a broader strategic operation than tactical military strikes alone. Darwish said the strikes are designed to establish a new reality within Syria and probe the limits of Syrian state sovereignty and military presence across the country.

The analyst rejected narrow interpretations that frame the strikes solely around the presence or absence of Turkish forces at the targeted facility at the moment of the attack. Instead, Darwish characterized the campaign as part of a wider strategic context aimed at testing Damascus's capacity to maintain control over its airspace and territory.
